title: Completed projection coherence data interfaces
statement: For small sites $X,Y$ with a morphism of topoi $f:Y\to X$ and a commutative Noetherian ring $A$ with ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], using constant $A$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the strict quotient towers, completions, units, finite coefficient reductions and adjunctions of [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison] [lem-sp-completed-pullback-adjunction] [lem-weil-ringed-tower-pushforward-limit-comparison] on the diagram sites [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization], and the ringed tensor corners, models and edges of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact], define: the corner of a site with a derived tensor; ordinary tensor data $o$ for $f$ (tensor models on both sites, a ringed tensor edge equal to the given geometric and derived pullback/pushforward and adjunction, and the canonical pullback/tensor comparison); its counit projection $\pi^o_{H,K}$ and strict-tower projection; completed tensor comparisons $b$ whose maps are the completions of the unit insertions, and the completed-adjunction projection mate $\pi^c$; scalar tensor balancing for the quotient $A\to A/I^{n+1}$ and finite tensor presentations $s_n$ with their target balancing and finite projection; and the predicates UnitEquation, Unique, LimitEquation, TransposeCompatibility, FiniteEquation and Natural. These are the unchanged definitions of lem-pur-compact-support-completed-projection-coherence, moved to a data module re-exported by the theorem module.
